item.title: EVAP opens EV showcase amid sales surge
item.description: The 14th Philippine Electric Vehicle Summit (PEVS) opened on 22 October at the SMX Convention Center in Pasay City, as sales of electrified vehicles continued to rise despite a decline in the country’s overall vehicle market.

item.title: Kimi’s Texas dream
item.description: Austin, United States (AFP) — Kimi Antonelli admitted on Thursday that he needs to have a “perfect weekend” at the United States Grand Prix to realize his dream of winning a maiden drivers’ world championship.

item.title: Lexus pairs hybrid, BEV at summit
item.description: Lexus has brought two different kinds of electrified vehicles to the 14th Philippine Electric Vehicle Summit, with the ES 350h Luxury hybrid sedan and the fully electric RZ SUV on display at the SMX Convention Center in Pasay City.

item.title: Power on parade: Toyota displays its electric and hybrid lineup at PEVS and unveils the Tamaraw MPUV at PITS
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) has brought its electric and hybrid lineup to the 14th Philippine Electric Vehicle Summit (PEVS), where visitors can see its latest battery-powered models alongside vehicles that have helped introduce Filipino motorists to hybrid technology.
